keyVerseDR: "Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased." (Mk 1:11)

level1.title: Jesus Is Baptized
level1.story: Jesus came to the Jordan River. John baptized Him. God said, "You are My beloved Son!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What came down like a dove?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for my baptism. Amen.

activity.title: I am God's child
activity.intro: Sign your baptismal name. God calls you His beloved child!

level2.title: You Are My Beloved Son
level2.story: John the Baptist preached, "There cometh after me One mightier than I." He said, "I have baptized you with water; but He shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost." Jesus came from Nazareth and was baptized by John in the Jordan. Coming up out of the water, He saw the heavens opened and the Spirit like a dove coming down upon Him. A voice came from heaven: "Thou art My beloved Son; in Thee I am well pleased."
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How do we see the Trinity at the Jordan?
level2.prayer: Father, thank You for calling me Your beloved. Amen.

activity.title: My baptismal promise
activity.intro: Bless yourself with holy water and remember your Baptism.

art.mainBrief: Jesus rising from the Jordan, heavens opening, dove
art.heartBrief: Shell and water drops; dove on top of heart
